purpose: Search for a signal with edge for the $1,000 agentic account WITHOUT fooling ourselves. Frozen before any round-1 number exists. Later rounds append; tests are counted across rounds.
universe: Every symbol with earnings+prices on disk from backtest_universe.json (202 run; 38 delisted/acquired names lack earnings data -- a survivorship gap that favours positive results and is disclosed).

account.rules: live quantcore sizing: 2% risk, 25% gap haircut, 18% cap, whole shares; anomaly block. A trade the $1,000 account cannot size is not counted.

periods.note: Holdout starts on the universe's listing-snapshot date, so the sampled stratum is survivorship-free there (apart from missing earnings data). Discovery is survivorship-exposed and is only a screen.

H1.idea: post-earnings drift after a beat, 1 month

H2.idea: post-earnings drift after a beat, 3 months

H3.idea: beat confirmed by the market's reaction

H4.idea: large positive earnings gap, regardless of the reported surprise

H5.idea: pre-announcement run-up, out before the number

discovery_screen: carry to holdout only if n>=100 trades, mean excess >= +0.50% per trade, and calendar-month t >= 2.39 (one-sided alpha 0.05/6).
holdout_confirmation: EDGE only if, with m = number carried: calendar-month t >= z(1 - 0.05/m), mean excess > 0 per trade at cost 0.10% AND still > 0 at 0.30%, n >= 50.
reported_regardless: every hypothesis's discovery numbers; the $1,000 replay for anything confirmed.
